set.body: Model row-side design geometry for multivariate regression and mixed-effect style decompositions. Add RowMetric, RowProjector, EffectTerm, EffectOperator, and typed fit artifacts for operator-valued effects. Acceptance: whitening/unwhitening and projector algebra are explicit; zero-rank and singular effect cases return typed errors or empty valid artifacts; effect reconstruction tests match multivarious mixed_regress/effect_operator behavior within tolerance.
set.title: Multivar row geometry: metrics, projectors, and effect operators
